components.purpose: Short request, startup, work, completion, and handoff router.
components.review_trigger: The router duplicates topic documents or becomes difficult to scan.
components.rollback: Restore the previous validated router revision.

components.purpose: Declare project commands and risk profiles as safe argument arrays.
components.applies_when: Always; project-specific values are required before activation.
components.review_trigger: A project command or required verification level changes.
components.rollback: Restore the previous configuration and rerun audit.

components.purpose: Machine truth for WIP, status, verification, evidence, and history.
components.review_trigger: A state transition cannot represent current project truth.
components.rollback: Restore the last receipt-backed feature state.

components.purpose: Bounded human snapshot of current state, risks, and next action.
components.review_trigger: The file accumulates history or disagrees with feature_list.json.
components.rollback: Rebuild the snapshot from current machine state and receipts.

components.purpose: Audit, state transitions, gate execution, receipts, and cold-start answers.
components.review_trigger: A false pass, unsafe command path, or non-actionable error appears.
components.rollback: Restore the previous script and validate existing receipts.

components.purpose: Answer the cold-start structure question and route boundary details.
components.applies_when: Always at summary level; add deeper boundary documents only when real boundaries exist.
components.review_trigger: A domain, dependency direction, or runtime surface changes.
components.rollback: Restore the last architecture map matching executable boundaries.

components.purpose: Explain staged gates and golden journeys.
components.applies_when: Always at summary level; enable stronger gates as risk increases.
components.review_trigger: A required gate is skipped or no longer matches project risk.
components.rollback: Restore the previous gate contract and reopen affected passing features.

components.purpose: Provide safe installation, configuration, validation, and removal steps.
components.applies_when: During initial adoption and whenever the Core contract is upgraded or removed.
components.review_trigger: A fresh adopter cannot complete installation without hidden knowledge.
components.rollback: Revert the adoption commit or remove only manifest-listed paths.

components.purpose: Import the shared AGENTS.md contract through a thin Claude Code entrypoint.
components.applies_when: When Claude-compatible agents may enter the repository.
components.review_trigger: The @AGENTS.md import is removed or Claude-specific text duplicates shared rules.
components.rollback: Restore the @AGENTS.md import and keep common rules in AGENTS.md.

components.purpose: Provide a stable, repeatable POSIX startup preflight.
components.review_trigger: Startup needs hidden manual steps or is unsafe to repeat.
components.rollback: Restore the previous wrapper and rerun the cold-start fixture twice.

components.purpose: Preserve upstream attribution and explain stable source identifiers.
components.review_trigger: Upstream source, license, or local inventory identifiers change.
components.rollback: Restore the last verified attribution record.

components.purpose: Machine ledger for every installed Core component and its source, trigger, validation, review, and rollback contract.
components.review_trigger: A managed Core file or its lifecycle contract changes.
components.rollback: Restore the last manifest that exactly covers the installed Core files.

components.purpose: Resolve all 65 stable source identifiers without requiring the starter design repository.
components.applies_when: Always, especially when redistributing an adapted Core.
components.review_trigger: The source inventory, disposition, or component mapping changes.
components.rollback: Restore the source map matching the installed component ledger.

components.purpose: Define versioned install, upgrade, backup, rollback, manual merge, and removal behavior.
components.review_trigger: The installer manifest schema, compatibility policy, or managed paths change.
components.rollback: Restore the prior lifecycle contract together with its compatible installer.

components.purpose: Expose the installed Core release under a Semantic Versioning contract.
components.review_trigger: Any distributed Core artifact or compatibility contract changes.
components.rollback: Restore the version matching the installed artifact set.

components.purpose: Provide the reusable starter under the MIT license.
components.rollback: Restore the license approved for the distributed release.

components.purpose: Preserve upstream attribution and distinguish the local adaptation.
components.review_trigger: Upstream attribution or adaptation ownership changes.
components.rollback: Restore the notice matching the distributed source and license.

components.purpose: Provide a native Windows PowerShell startup preflight equivalent to the POSIX init wrapper.
components.applies_when: Always on supported native Windows PowerShell environments; preserve launcher discovery, repository-root working directory, setup argument forwarding, and child exit-code propagation.
components.review_trigger: PowerShell launcher discovery, argument forwarding, working-directory, exit-code, or native Windows support behavior changes.
components.rollback: Restore the previous validated PowerShell wrapper and rerun its launcher, setup, working-directory, and exit-code contract fixtures.
